notice: Declared relation vocabulary for catalog relationship records. Declared algebraic properties are recorded for a future derived projection and are NEVER applied to authority records: this file does not enable entailment. Evidentiary grade is deliberately absent from this file, because an authority store's accepted basis is not deployment-configurable. See docs/decisions/0009-declared-ontology-and-entailment.md.

version-of.description: The subject is reported to be another version of the object.

duplicate-of.description: The subject is reported to carry the same content as the object. Not transitive: chained duplicates do not establish mutual duplication.

rendition-of.description: The subject is reported to be a rendition extracted or converted from the object. Not transitive: fidelity does not compose across conversions.

same-event.description: The subject and object are reported to concern the same event. Not transitive: transitive closure would merge distinct events.
